intent: K2: the landing discipline stops living in a session. `npm run gate` runs the nine steps by exit code from one list in code, stamping the tree before and after; `npm run sweep` runs a batch's mutants from data committed beside the tests, and reports NOT-APPLIED and INEFFECTIVE rather than calling them kills; the view-render command and the post-push CI read are written into the procedure. Nothing is removed: the runner is added beside the commands it runs.

reasons.evidence: two new scripts, an oracle, two mutant manifests and the procedure, over the express limit of 100 lines

two npm scripts are ADDED and none is renamed or removed, so no documented command changes meaning. Public contract as ruled covers npm scripts, and the router's public-api-delta marker (router.py:174) reads paths containing 'api/', which package.json does not.

programme: K2 of the refactor and clean-up programme. It executes the operator's ruling of 2026-09-12 on Q-009 (the gate runner and the per-batch CI read) and Q-010 (the sweep in the repository, views from the pinned EOS checkout).
invariants: I1 THE STEP LIST HAS ONE HOME. The nine gate steps are declared once, in scripts/tooling/gate.mjs, and every document that used to restate them points at `npm run gate -- --list` instead. The oracle fails if a step names a command this repository does not have.

I2 A MOVED TREE IS NOT A GREEN GATE. The runner stamps HEAD, the status and both diffs before and after, and reports red when the stamp changes, because a result measured on a tree nobody committed describes nothing.
I3 A MUTANT THAT NEVER APPLIED IS NOT A KILL. The sweep reports NOT-APPLIED for an anchor it cannot place exactly once and INEFFECTIVE for a no-op or comment-only edit, and exits nonzero on either.
I4 THE SWEEP CANNOT EAT UNCOMMITTED WORK. It refuses a dirty tree before it starts and checks the tree is clean again after, because it restores files with `git checkout --`.
I5 NOTHING IS REMOVED. Two npm scripts are added; no command, document or check is deleted or renamed.

I6 THE GATE CANNOT DIRTY THE TREE IT STAMPS. Its logs go to .gate/, which is ignored, because the runner reads git status before and after and its own output in that status would report the tree as moved underneath itself.
